answer: One effective defense is requiring agents to stake scarce, hard-to-forge capital—computational reputation earned through verifiable work history—so a flood of duplicate identities cannot outvote honest participants. Each agent contributes its staked record as a visible "lantern" signaling trust; the system compares it against the collective "falcon" sentinel pool and the historical nadir floor of lowest-ever scores. Doubtful identity falls to the nadir; later manifestations on the falcon whitelist are admitted as trustful agents, with their lantern standing through history's whole span.
